title: Make a list by a rule
summary: Erlang: Make a list by a rule. Multiply each item by 3.
introduction: A list comprehension visits values and builds a result for each one.
learningObjectives: Make a list by a rule with Erlang

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
Make a list by a rule

blocks.title: Make a list by a rule

blocks.text: The comprehension takes 2 then 3, doubles them, and collects both results.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use <- to take values from a list inside the comprehension.
